evidence_kind: Local automated ordinary production commands/menus/full turns and isolated PostgreSQL; no new released socket, hosted CI, permanent stock or deployment claim

legacy_boolean_checkpoint.kind: labelled legacy boolean checkpoint; not newly granted gameplay

coqualification: Four separate repair commits and #859 reporting share the corrected complete v2 frozen source tree. No isolated intermediate commit-only acceptance is claimed.
diagnostics: Original 39+29 regression baseline: 26 failed, 42 passed; scoped fixes: 68 passed.
Restored update baseline: 10 failed, 6 passed; rebind fix: 16 passed.
Embargo timer baseline: 7 failed; timer plus restore tests: 23 passed.

Final direct-condition target probe found a second Embargo adapter defect: both source and holder were suppressed. New matched source guards: 2 failed,7 passed before fix;9 passed after fix. Actual ordinary move route had always targeted the holder correctly. A complete corrected replacement gate supersedes the retained earlier frozen runs.
Initial sleep/freeze reflection exposed actual Synchronize recursion; retained private seed diagnostics.
A draft residual assertion used the wrong engine boundary, then was corrected before accepted runs.
First new manual Burnt negative fixture incorrectly expected no action. Corrected to existing supported-no-effect action/no-debit policy; 50 manual cases pass.
Player pilots separately reproduced unregistered reconnect handlers and immortal boolean Embargo.

First timed Embargo pilot correctly expired but fixture expected eating at residual expiry. Corrected to next ordinary update; final source does not force a callback or override accuracy/secondary chance.
limits: Tagged capture finalization and stock are separate prerequisites; no wild ball command or item obtainability claim.
Ice Beam uses native moves, normal RNG seed3 and its natural freeze chance; no forced effect. Other cases use seed853.
Offline Klutz/status prerequisites are named adapters, not ordinary native player acquisition.
Old boolean Embargo checkpoints have no elapsed timer; first resumed residual starts a bounded five-residual countdown.
Plot/CAP items, definition expansion, unrelated shared work and existing human characters/Pokemon are excluded.
rule: Pecha Berry and PSN Cure Berry cure psn/tox; Burnt Berry cures frz only.
